title.narrative: Air Quality Improvement in the Greater Beijing–Tianjin–Hebei Region–Green Financing Scale up Project

description.narrative: The proposed project uses the financial intermediation loan modality, which is the best fit to support geographically scattered investments while maximizing ADB's loan leveraging capacity through revolving the loan fund and mobilizing domestic funds. It aims to address emerging challenges in air quality improvement and GHG emission reduction in both the greater BTH and YRD regions through energy efficiency, cleaner transport systems development, renewable energy development, and cooling systems retrofit. It also stimulates post COVID-19 recovery investment with build-back-better principles by continuously scaling up clean energy technologies and systems applications in the targeted regions, which account for around 50% of the gross domestic product in the PRC. The project will support key strategic pillars of ADB's Strategy 2030: (i) tackling climate change, building climate and disaster resilience, and enhancing environmental sustainability by accelerating low greenhouse gas emissions development and ensuring environmental sustainability; (ii) strengthening governance and institutional capacity by providing inclusive financial services for clean energy investment; and (iii) accelerating progress in achieving gender equality through gender mainstreaming activities.

Reports and Recommendations of the President

By the end of June 2022, an entrusted loan subproject and a guaranty subproject were implemented under the Green Financing Scale up Project, with a total investment of CNY1.44 billion. After completion, they are estimated to reduce 1,414.6 tons of coal consumption yearly, contributing to annual emission reduction of CO2 by 107,558.00 tons, SO2 by 7.4 tons, NOx by 72.1 tons, and PM by 3.44 tons.
In August 2022, a gender training was delivered at the 3rd China Clean Heating Industry Summit, which was attended by more than 60 female managers or investors.
Loan 4023: 61% of contracts awarded and 61% disbursed as of 21 Apr 2025
One electrical vehicle purchase subproject was implemented.

Progress Toward Outcome: As of June 2023, two clean air bond guaranty subprojects and five entrusted loan subprojects have been implemented. After completion, they are estimated to reduce 6,664.01 tons of coal consumption yearly, contributing to annual emission reduction of CO2 by 126,548.02 tons, SO2 by 7.4 tons, NOx by 116.18 tons, PM by 3.71 tons and HFC 231.14 tons.
Some results are in the Audited Project Financial Statements | Jun 2024: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51033/51033-001-apfs-en_0.pdf
Some results are in the ESMS Performance/Implementation Reports | Jan 2025: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51033/51033-001-esmspr-en_0.pdf
Some results are in the Environmental and Social Monitoring Reports | Jan 2023: https://www.adb.org/sites/default/files/project-documents/51033/51033-001-esmr-en_1.pdf

Status of Implementation Progress: AS of June 2023, seven subprojects implemented will leverage total investment of CNY2.02 billion; three chilled water storage construction subprojects have been implemented; gender training was delivered with more than 60 female managers or investors; CNY527 million of CAB issued; an online operating system for MSMEs has been developed and is operational; 54.16% of PMO staff are female investment managers; all GFP staff have participated in trainings on gender equality and financial inclusion.
